import Mathlib

theorem p08 : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ p, N < p ∧ Nat.Prime p := by
  intro N
  obtain ⟨p, hNp, hp⟩ := Nat.exists_infinite_primes (N + 1)
  exact ⟨p, Nat.lt_of_succ_le hNp, hp⟩
